mapper.insert: insert into POST (POST_ID, POST_TITLE, POST_CONTENT, POST_FILE, VIEW_COUNT, USR_ID, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) values (POST_SEQ.nextval, #{postTitle}, #{postContent}, #{postFile, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, #{usrId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: select POST_ID as postId, POST_TITLE as postTitle, POST_CONTENT as postContent, POST_FILE as postFile, VIEW_COUNT as viewCount, USR_ID as usrId, CREATED_AT as createdAt, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt from POST where POST_ID = #{postId}

select POST_ID as postId, POST_TITLE as postTitle, POST_CONTENT as postContent, POST_FILE as postFile, VIEW_COUNT as viewCount, USR_ID as usrId, CREATED_AT as createdAt, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt from POST where POST_TITLE like '%' || #{search} || '%' or USR_ID like '%' || #{search} || '%' or POST_CONTENT like '%' || #{search} || '%'
mapper.update: update POST set POST_TITLE = #{postTitle}, POST_CONTENT = #{postContent}, POST_FILE = #{postFile, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE where POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENTS (COMMENT_ID, POST_ID, USR_ID, CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (COMMENTS_SEQ.nextval, #{postId}, #{usrId}, #{content}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE POST SET LIKES = #{likes} WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM COMMENTS WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC
